recipes.Name: Fuse Runes
recipes.Recipe: 3 identical Tier I-II runes
recipes.Result: 1 rune, the next one up the ladder (the 3 runes are used up)

recipes.Name: Kindled Ascent
recipes.Recipe: 2 identical Tier I-II runes + any jewel
recipes.Result: 1 rune, the next one up the ladder (the 2 runes and the jewel are used up)

recipes.Name: Tempered Ascent
recipes.Recipe: 3 identical Tier III runes + a Faceted or Radiant jewel
recipes.Result: 1 rune, the next one up the ladder (the runes and the jewel are used up)

recipes.Name: Dawnbinding
recipes.Recipe: 3 identical Tier IV runes + a Faceted or Radiant jewel
recipes.Result: 1 Tier V rune, the next one up the ladder (the runes and the jewel are used up)

recipes.Name: Oathfire
recipes.Recipe: 3 identical Tier V runes + 2 Radiant jewels
recipes.Result: the next Tier V rune up the ladder (the runes and jewels are used up)

recipes.Name: Rune Turning
recipes.Recipe: 2 runes of one tier (I-IV)
recipes.Result: 1 random other rune of the same tier, never a higher one (both runes are used up)

recipes.Name: The Six Kindlings
recipes.Recipe: one of each of the six Tier I runes
recipes.Result: 1 random Tier III rune (the six runes are used up)
recipes.Hint: Six small runes, no two alike, sing one deeper note.

recipes.Name: Rune Breaking
recipes.Recipe: 1 rune of Tier II to V + a Rough jewel
recipes.Result: 2 of the top rune of the tier below it (the rune and the jewel are used up; red runes do not break)
recipes.Hint: The roughest stone can split a rune back into its makers.

recipes.Name: Red Rune Turning
recipes.Recipe: 3 red runes of any kind + a Radiant jewel
recipes.Result: 1 red rune of your choice

recipes.Name: Jewel Polishing
recipes.Recipe: 3 identical jewels (Rough to Faceted)
recipes.Result: 1 jewel of the same family, one cut finer (the 3 jewels are used up)

recipes.Name: The Prism
recipes.Recipe: an Ember, a Frost and a Storm jewel of one cut
recipes.Result: 1 Prism jewel of that cut (the 3 jewels are used up)
recipes.Hint: Fire, frost and storm, cut alike, fold into one light.

recipes.Name: Jewel Kindling
recipes.Recipe: 2 identical jewels (Rough to Faceted) + a Tier III+ rune
recipes.Result: 1 jewel of the same family, one cut finer (the jewels and the rune are used up)
recipes.Hint: Two twin jewels are one short. A strong rune pays for the third.

recipes.Name: Jewel Cleaving
recipes.Recipe: one jewel alone (Cut or finer)
recipes.Result: 2 jewels of the same family, one cut rougher

recipes.Name: Jewel Turning
recipes.Recipe: 3 jewels of one cut
recipes.Result: 1 random jewel of the same cut, any family, never finer (the 3 jewels are used up)

recipes.Name: Rune Pressing
recipes.Recipe: 3 runes of one tier (I-III)
recipes.Result: 1 random jewel, one cut finer than the runes' tier (the 3 runes are used up)

recipes.Name: Jewel Binding
recipes.Recipe: 4 jewels of one cut (Cut or finer)
recipes.Result: 1 random rune of the jewels' tier (the 4 jewels are used up)

recipes.Name: Oathmark
recipes.Recipe: a rare + a Tier V rune + a Radiant jewel
recipes.Result: the same rare with one more socket past its limit (up to 2); its mods stay
recipes.Hint: The highest rune and the finest stone can break a rare's oath.

recipes.Name: Socket Boring
recipes.Recipe: a magic or rare weapon, body armour, helmet or shield + any rune + any jewel
recipes.Result: the same item with one more socket (magic up to 2, rare up to 1); its mods stay

recipes.Name: Family Reforge
recipes.Recipe: a rare + 3 jewels of one family
recipes.Result: the rare with ALL its mods rerolled, one sure to be of the jewels' family; base, sockets and level stay

recipes.Name: Family Imbuing
recipes.Recipe: a plain white weapon or armour + 3 jewels of one family
recipes.Result: a magic item of the same base, one mod sure to be of the jewels' family

recipes.Name: Awakening
recipes.Recipe: a magic item or a magic idol + 2 jewels of Cut or finer
recipes.Result: a rare of the same base and item level, all its mods new (this is how a magic idol becomes a rare idol)

recipes.Name: Restring
recipes.Recipe: a magic item + any jewel
recipes.Result: the magic item with ALL its mods rerolled; base and level stay

recipes.Name: Base Ascension
recipes.Recipe: any gear + 1 rune of Tier III or higher + 2 jewels of any colour, each Cut, Faceted or Radiant
recipes.Result: the same item on the next base of its kind (same defence type, never lower); mods and sockets stay

recipes.Name: Retempering
recipes.Recipe: a rare + 2 Tier II+ runes + a jewel of Cut or finer
recipes.Result: the rare with ALL its mods rolled again; its item level rises to this Rupture's monster level (84 at most). Works only when that monster level is above the item's level

recipes.Name: Runesmith's Base
recipes.Recipe: a plain white weapon or armour (ML 30+) + 3 identical Tier I runes
recipes.Result: the same white base with its most sockets

recipes.Name: Red Ascent
recipes.Recipe: 3 reds of one tier (I-III)
recipes.Result: 1 random red of the next tier (the 3 reds are used up)

recipes.Name: Red Turning
recipes.Recipe: 2 reds of one tier + any rune
recipes.Result: 1 random other red of the same tier; red Dwarven Runes and red idols stay in their kind (the reds and the rune are used up)

recipes.Name: Red Descent
recipes.Recipe: a red of Tier II to IV + any rune
recipes.Result: 1 random red of the tier below it (the red and the rune are used up)

recipes.Name: Red Reawakening
recipes.Recipe: a red + 2 jewels of Cut or finer
recipes.Result: the same red, its values rerolled inside their ranges (can roll lower); tier stays. Reds with fixed values are refused

recipes.Name: Red Retempering
recipes.Recipe: a red + a Tier IV+ rune + a Faceted or Radiant jewel
recipes.Result: the same red, its values rolled again in their ranges; its item level rises to this Rupture's monster level (84 at most). Reds with fixed values are refused

recipes.Name: Red Unmaking
recipes.Recipe: a red alone
recipes.Result: 2 random jewels, finer for a higher tier (the red is destroyed)

recipes.Name: The Perfect Echo
recipes.Recipe: two copies of the same red
recipes.Result: one red with every value at its best (the other copy is used up)
recipes.Hint: Two reds, the same in all but luck, keep only their best.

recipes.Name: Vowbinding: the Mark
recipes.Recipe: a red + a Marked base of the same kind + a Tier V+ rune
recipes.Result: the same red on the Marked base: every red value kept, the Mark becomes its implicit, the higher item level
recipes.Hint: A red may leave its body for one the Core has touched, if a high rune pays the toll.

recipes.Name: Vowbinding: a Vow
recipes.Recipe: a red + a rare of the same slot + a Tier V+ rune (the first Vow; then 2, 4, 6, 8, 10 red runes)
recipes.Result: the same red with the rare's finest mod (best tier first, never its Oathsworn line) as a Vow; each Vow counts for less than the one before (100, 85, 70, 60, 50, 40%); a Vow of the same kind is replaced
recipes.Hint: Feed a red the finest line of a rare that shares its place: a high stone for the first vow, red stones for every vow after.

recipes.Name: Sigil Binding
recipes.Recipe: 3 Tier III or IV sigils + 1 red rune
recipes.Result: 1 Unique Sigil in your pouch: a reward past the cap and a crimson penalty (the sigils are used up)
recipes.Hint: Three strong sigils and one red stone bind into a map key no Gemwright sells.

recipes.Name: Idol Merging
recipes.Recipe: 3 magic 1-cell idols + any jewel
recipes.Result: 1 idol of 3 cells (1x3 or 3x1); it keeps the FIRST idol's first line at the bigger size (value rolled again in its tier), its other line is new (the 3 idols and the jewel are used up)

recipes.Name: Idol Fusing
recipes.Recipe: 3 magic 2-cell idols + a jewel of Cut or finer
recipes.Result: 1 idol of 4 cells (1x4 or 4x1); it keeps the FIRST idol's first line at the bigger size (value rolled again in its tier), its other line is new (the 3 idols and the jewel are used up)

recipes.Name: Blank Slate
recipes.Recipe: a magic or rare weapon, body armour, helmet or shield + 2 Tier II+ runes
recipes.Result: the same base as a plain white, its item level, Mark, Quality and sockets kept (every mod is used up)

recipes.Name: Oathsworn
recipes.Recipe: a rare + a Tier V+ rune + 3 Core Embers (from your Forge store)
recipes.Result: the same rare + a 7th line, its Oathsworn line: a new mod at the top tier its item level allows (again: that line rolls again; a Vow never copies it)

recipes.Name: Idol Tempering
recipes.Recipe: a magic or rare idol + 1 Tier III or IV rune
recipes.Result: the same idol: every line keeps its kind, its tier and value are rolled again within the idol's item level (it can be worse)

recipes.Name: Resist Turning
recipes.Recipe: an item with a resistance line + 1 Tier I to IV rune + 1 Core Ember (from your Forge store)
recipes.Result: your spare resistance line turns into the one you lack most (Fire, Cold, Lightning; Poison from Rupture Level 100), same tier, same roll

recipes.Name: Idol Turning
recipes.Recipe: a magic or rare idol of 2 to 4 cells + 1 Tier I or II rune
recipes.Result: the same idol turned on its side (1x3 becomes 3x1, and back): every line, its tier and its roll kept

materials.Name: Ember
materials.Text: A coal that never cools. Tier I crafts.

materials.Name: Glyph Shard
materials.Text: A shard of a dwarven glyph. Tier II crafts, and unmaking a crafted mod.

materials.Name: Oathsteel
materials.Text: Steel from a broken vow. Tier III crafts.

materials.Name: Ember Whetstone
materials.Text: Sharpens a weapon: +5% Quality on a white, +2% on magic, +1% on rare or unique, up to 20%.

materials.Name: Ember Rivet
materials.Text: Mends an armour piece: +5% Quality on a white, +2% on magic, +1% on rare or unique, up to 20%.

materials.Name: Heartwood
materials.Text: Living wood from Myrh Forest. Pays for the forest's recipes.

materials.Name: Sunstone
materials.Text: A stone that holds the desert's noon. Pays for the Desolated Plains' recipes.

materials.Name: Frost-Iron
materials.Text: Iron that never thaws. Pays for the snow lands' recipes.

materials.Name: Massadian Essence
materials.Text: Ember-light bottled in the Massadian Fire Lands. Pays for the Fire Lands' recipes.

materials.Name: Bog Amber
materials.Text: Sap the swamp turned to stone. Pays for the Kabarian Swamp's recipes.

materials.Name: Gloomsilver
materials.Text: Silver that grew where no light reaches. Rupture Guardians from Rupture Level 150 carry it, more the higher you push, and every Catacomb Depth Cache pays some.

materials.Name: Oathcinder
materials.Text: What is left when an oath burns. At the Forge it Unswears a rare, a red or a finished Oathword: Kept 25%, Scarred 25% (one more line), Twisted 25% (every value x0.8 to x1.2), Broken 20% (a new rare), Shattered 5% (the item is destroyed). After it, the Forge and the Cube can no longer change it (Quality still can, and a rare or red can still take a socket; an Oathword's runes are bound for good).

materials.Name: Core Ember
materials.Text: A coal from the heart of a Core Rupture, still burning with the broken oath. Tier IV crafts: the Skyforge.
